video_title: Anthony Edwards and Kimi Antonelli are the best Spades Duo

quotes.speaker: Anthony Edwards
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Edwards explains the basic rules of Spades to Kimi Antonelli
quotes.excerpt: The highest card in the suit wins. Aces is the highest card.

text_blocks.speaker: Anthony Edwards
text_blocks.text: It is simple. Open, close, bid. I am closing the bid. You have your books, let's say you have three books. So you tell me, and I have three. Let's say we are going seven. I say we are going seven, and that is what we are going. No more talking, we are just playing cards. Just match every suit. So, hearts play a heart.

text_blocks.speaker: Andrea Kimi Antonelli
text_blocks.text: If I see this, I understand it better.

text_blocks.speaker: Anthony Edwards
text_blocks.text: The highest card in the suit wins. Aces is the highest card. My fault, it goes Ace, King, Queen.
